rows.en:
(Sheryl transferred to our school, but I wonder
if I'll ever get a chance to talk to her...)
Hey, you there!
Huh? Me?
...Wait... Sheryl!?
Who else is there? Don't waste my time.
Oh, sorry!
Well, whatever. Hey, you. Show me around the school.
Huh? You want me to do it?
Who else did you think I meant?
...And that about covers it.

Hmm~ This school's a pretty nice place.
Looks like I'll enjoy my school life here.
Yes, I hope you do.
Oh, that's right. You!

Um... your name is... if I remember right...
\p?
Yes, that's right, but...
Your tour wasn't half bad, either.
If anything comes up, I'll ask you again. See you.
Oh, okay!

(A chance to talk to Sheryl... and it came
right away...)

(Sheryl-san transferred to our school, but I
wonder if I'll ever get a chance to talk to her...)
Huh? Me?
...Wait, Sheryl-san!?
Oh, I'm sorry!
Huh? You want me to?
Hmm, all right.
Yes, I hope you do.
Hm? Yes?

Um... your name is... if I remember right...
\p-chan?
Yeah, that's right, but...
Sure, anytime.
(Sheryl-san's friendlier than I expected.)
(Huh? Sheryl's calling me again...?)
Hey, \p.

I kind of forgot how to get to the place you
showed me the other day. Will you show me again?

If you know where you want to go, it doesn't
have to be me...
Did you say something?
No, nothing...

I see, I've got it this time. Thank you.
I'll be counting on you if anything else comes up.

(I don't mind showing Sheryl around, but I'd
rather not have to do it that many times...)
(Huh? Sheryl-san's calling me again...?)
Hey, \p-chan.

If you know where you want to go, it doesn't
have to be me...

(I don't mind showing Sheryl-san around, but
maybe not quite that many times...)

(Sheryl told me, "Take me somewhere
interesting at school," but... this is a school,
you know...)

\p.
So, where will you be taking me?
Um, I don't know if you'll enjoy it, but...
Hee hee, I'm expecting great things.
(Hmm, will this really be okay?)

What, the library!?
This is your idea of an interesting place? Honestly...

Yeah, but this school has all kinds of departments,
so the collection's huge, with tons of
interesting books.

Interesting books, huh... Well, fine!
Bring me a book you think is interesting!
Huh? But the fun is in finding one your...
rows.notes: Interrupted line; cut before the end as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Quit your grumbling and go get one, quick!
If it isn't interesting, you'll be sorry!
(Oh boy... What am I supposed to bring her...)
(Maybe I'll see how she reacts to this one...)
Sorry to keep you waiting. How about this book?

You took your time. How long did you plan to keep
me waiting? Well, fine, hand it ov...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word ('yokoshinasa...'), kept as 'hand it ov...'.

rows.en:
Wow, what's this!? Isn't it lovely!
What's this book called?

Uh, I think it says on the cover...
It's a sweets recipe book called
"Handpicked! Galactic Sweets Paradise."
rows.notes: Book title 'Gensen! Ginga no Suiitsu Tengoku' rendered 'Handpicked! Galactic Sweets Paradise' (also c13665). Reordered: title before 'recipe book' within the same row.

rows.en: Ooh, how cute~
Oh, this one looks sooo delicious!
How is it?
Mm-hmm, hippo-cow cream, huh...
Ahh! This one looks sooo cute too~!

(Looks like she likes it.
Maybe I'll look for some more.)

Huh!? There's a yoga pose like this!?
But it looks biologically impossible...

Hmm, so Nyan-Nyan has this kind of history...
I had no idea!

So this is what they call a maid cafe...!?
This outfit is so cute~!
...So, how was it?
Ugh, well... I guess it was fun enough.
I'm glad to hear it!

Today wasn't bad either. I'll be counting on
you again.
Anytime.
(I think she had fun today too.)

(Sheryl-san asked me to "take her somewhere
interesting at school," but... this is a school...)

\p-chan,
where will you be taking me today?
Um, I'm not sure you'll enjoy it, but...
(Hmm, will this really be okay?)
(Oh dear... What should I bring her...)
(Maybe I'll see how she reacts to this one.)
